a.xlink:title: Kernel micro standard library.
ATA/IDE disk driver (DMA + PIO fallback, LBA28/48).
Boot/panic logger on the linear framebuffer.
Block + inode allocation bitmap operations.
Direct + indirect block resolution and reservation for ext2.
Single-block scratch pool for one-off ext2 metadata reads.
High-level directory operations — readdir, mkdir, unlink, rmdir.
On-disk directory entry primitives — lookup, insert, remove, emptiness check.
File open / close / read / write / truncate / flush — the public ext2 byte-oriented API.
On-disk inode read + write.
fs_ops_t bridge for ext2.
Path resolution, symlink following, and the ext2_stat / ext2_readlink endpoints.
Block-level I/O, superblock + GDT writeback, volume bring-up.
Read-only, flat ramfs populated from Limine boot modules.
Standalone ramfs driver for Alcor2.
Virtual File System orchestration layer.
/dev/null, /dev/zero, and /dev/tty character devices.
Runtime framebuffer text console with UTF-8 and ANSI/CSI support.
Userspace atlas submission pipeline for the framebuffer console.
Dirty-cell flush batch + character emission for the framebuffer console.
Scrollback ring + deferred pixel-scroll for the framebuffer console.
Framebuffer physical range + geometry for user mmap.
Kernel mouse broker.
PS/2 scancode translator: layout mapping, line discipline, and TTY I/O.
Default termios (canonical + echo) for new processes.
Kernel entry point and bring-up sequence.
Process lifecycle, scheduling, fork/exec/exit, and context switching.
ELF64 executable loader: validation, PT_LOAD mapping, file or memory copy, user entry.
Anonymous pipes backed by a fixed-size ring buffer.
POSIX signal system calls and delivery mechanism.
Numbered syscall lookup and dispatch.
Syscalls: framebuffer info + mmap (userspace drawing / font stacks).
Filesystem syscalls: open, close, stat, seek, rename, chdir, …
I/O syscalls: read, readv, write, writev, lseek, ioctl, nanosleep, select, poll.
Misc syscalls: uname, time, minimal futex, sched_yield.
Memory syscalls: mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk.
Process syscalls: PID queries, fork, exec, wait, clone, identity.
Compiler ABI built-in shims.
Kernel micro-library implementation (strings, memory).
Kernel heap allocator implementation.
x86_64 virtual memory manager (PML4 → PT, address-space clone, tear down user maps).
